WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS START_DATE , TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1 AS END_DATE , #{GB_ID} AS GB_ID , #{GB_NM} AS GB_NM , C##RG.ENC_B64(#{name}) AS NAME , #{id} AS ID FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.cscghvrtrkng.mapper.ClienaGhvrTrkngMapper.selectClienaGhvrTrkngList : 내담자행동추적 LIST */ C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.USER_NM_ENCPT) || '(' || AA.USER_ID || ')' AS FLNM , TO_CHAR(AA.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MM:SS') AS REG_DT , AA.MBR_TRACNH_DTL_CN , AA.USER_ID , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM ZZ , AYC480 AA /* 회원추적체크 */ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.REG_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND AA.REG_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
AND AA.USER_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%'
AND CC.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME
AND (AA.USER_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%' OR AA.USER_NM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME )
ORDER BY AA.FRST_REG_DT DESC
